extraction.policy_summary: BSE states it has an equal opportunity policy as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016: 'Company is deeply committed to fostering a workplace culture that embraces the principles of equal opportunity... We ensure non-discrimination and respect for persons with disabilities and believe in providing equal employment opportunity to all groups of people.'
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As at end of FY 2025-26, BSE reports 1 total differently abled employee (1 male, 100%; 0 female), all Permanent, and 0 total differently abled workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: BSE describes specific physical accessibility measures: 'Ramps have been installed at the entrance gates to ensure barrier-free access. In addition, wheelchairs are made available to facilitate ease of movement within the premises. Designated urinals have been provided at specific locations to ensure accessibility for specially abled individuals. Additionally, an exclusive lift has been made available for use by specially abled persons to facilitate ease of movement within the premises.' This is confirmed again in the visitor-accessibility answer (ramps at entrance gates, wheelchairs available on-site).
extraction.compliance_details: BSE affirmatively answers the mandated BRSR statutory questions on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016: premises accessible to differently abled employees and workers ('Yes', with described ramps/wheelchairs/urinals/lift); an equal opportunity policy in place; and premises accessible to differently abled visitors ('Yes').
